shapeSummary: Solid rubber tire modeled as a 58 mm diameter, 16 mm wide cylinder with its axis along Y, spanning Y=0 to 16 and centered at X=Z=0. Both outer edges have a 5 mm round, and the front face has a shallow 3 mm deep, 42 mm diameter recess that stands in for the hub face.
warnings: Diameter and width come from unverified specs.
The hub is simplified to a shallow recess in a single solid; the separate hub part is not modeled.
The central bore, shaft hole (4 mm round or 3 mm hex), the three screws and the rear standoffs are omitted because their sizes and positions are uncertain.
The 5 mm edge round and the 21 mm recess radius and 3 mm depth are estimated from the image.
